## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `develop` (or `main` for a `release:` / urgent hotfix PR)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (typecheck + tests + build)
- [ ] Added / updated tests for the change
- [ ] Added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Commit prefix reflects the intended bump (`fix:`/`chore:` = patch, `feat:` = minor, `feat!:` = major)
- [ ] Updated docs (README / RELEASING) where needed

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [RELEASING.md](../RELEASING.md).
